na_skrywer.voor: Iemand wat die medisyne elke dag drink

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The next sentences switch to 'sy' who goes to school 'soos enige ander kind', so the vague 'Iemand' leaves the pronoun without a clear referent; naming the child the text already describes fixes the reference without adding content.
na_skrywer.fout: The pronoun 'Sy' and 'soos enige ander kind' follow a genderless, ageless 'Iemand', so the reference is loose.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The reference fault is real, but 'n Kind narrows a general claim about anyone on the medicine to children only, so the writer must choose the fix.

vlae.blok: MIV en VIGS is nie dieselfde nie
vlae.teks: Dit beteken nie dat elke mens met MIV VIGS sal kry nie.
vlae.rede: The two abbreviations stand side by side ('MIV VIGS') and a Grade 4 reader may stumble; a fix such as 'elke mens wat MIV het, VIGS sal kry' adds a word, and the study text may not get longer, so it is flagged rather than changed.

vlae.rede: 'haar' refers back to the gender-neutral 'Iemand' / 'jou onderwyser'; standard generic reference would be 'hom', but the female pronoun may be a deliberate choice (the medicine block also uses 'sy'), so it is not changed.

vlae.teks: Wanneer MIV die liggaam se afweer teen siekte baie swak gemaak het.
vlae.rede: The definition opens with 'Wanneer', so it names a time rather than a thing; the study text frames it as 'die naam vir wat gebeur wanneer ...'. A fix lengthens the entry, so it is flagged for the reviewer or writer.
